scripts.predev: node scripts/prepare-prism-gpu-benchmarks.mjs && node scripts/prepare-ort-assets.mjs && node scripts/prepare-depth-models.mjs && node scripts/ingest-examples.mjs && pnpm run examples-api:generate
scripts.prebuild: pnpm run build:workspace && node scripts/prepare-prism-gpu-benchmarks.mjs && node scripts/prepare-ort-assets.mjs && node scripts/prepare-depth-models.mjs && node scripts/ingest-examples.mjs && pnpm run examples-api:generate
scripts.$comment:typecheck: `typecheck` needs a prior `build` (or at least `prebuild`): Next's generated route types (`.next/types`) and the fumadocs-mdx generated source collections are only written by the build/dev pipeline, and `tsc --noEmit` fails on missing generated modules without them.
scripts.$comment:tgeist-ml-assets: TGEIST-ML-ASSETS: `check:ml-asset-smoke` starts `next start` on the production build and GETs every committed ONNX model + /ort/manifest.json + the staged depth models, asserting 200, no x-middleware-rewrite (the i18n proxy rewriting the asset to /en/... before it reaches the static file) and byte-identical content. Closes the gate hole TGEIST-14 found: `next build` and `thumbs:check` both pass with these assets 404ing under the proxy.
scripts.$comment:tgeist-examples-static: TGEIST-EXAMPLES-STATIC: sibling of check:ml-asset-smoke, same failure mode, different asset class. `check:example-static-asset-smoke` starts `next start` on the production build and GETs every file committed under public/examples/** (the <slug>.card.png / <slug>.hero.png thumbnails and depth-estimation/source.jpg), asserting 200, no x-middleware-rewrite, and byte-identical content -- plus re-asserting a few /examples/[slug] page routes are still proxied (still localized), so an over-broad fix can't silently swallow the pages instead of just the assets. See the ANCHOR TGEIST-EXAMPLES-STATIC comment in proxy.ts.
scripts.$comment:tgeist-05: TGEIST-05: `test:remark` unit-tests the M1-M9 remark plugins (node:test, no runner dependency: the root vitest config only picks up *.test.ts under apps/docs, so this .mjs suite still needs its own runner). `check:mdast-parity` is gate (c) of Decision 4 — it also asserts every surviving fence language is one Shiki can load (M4) and that no *.docs.md / bare logical link survives (M7/M8).
scripts.$comment:tgeist-06: TGEIST-06: `check:examples-api-tracing` runs after next build and asserts the prebuild-generated artifact tree really is bundled into each of the 4 routes (they read it with fs at request time, so only outputFileTracingIncludes puts it in the lambda). Its sibling `check:examples-api-transplant` (gate G2: the byte-identity diff of this app's examples API against the pre-migration app's copy) was deleted at cutover, together with the copy it compared against.
scripts.$comment:tgeist-08: TGEIST-08: `check:example-bundles` measures the production chunks of the /preview/[slug] routes and grades them against scripts/example-chunk-budgets.json, whose numbers were re-measured against THIS app (Grupo D re-baseline; the script's algorithm is the pre-migration app's, unchanged apart from accepting either app directory name in its WGSL source markers). It reads .next/static/chunks and never builds, so it must run right after `build` in the same job -- it refuses to grade chunks older than the sources anyway.
scripts.$comment:tgeist-12: TGEIST-12: gate (d) of Decision 4 plus the schema check its siblings rely on. `check:url-anchor-parity` starts `next start` on the production build itself (so next.config redirects and the geistdocs i18n proxy are in the loop) and asserts every URL + anchor frozen from prod in docs/url-inventory.json still resolves; pass `--json=<file>` to keep the report and `--write-allowlist` to re-record known slugger renames. `check:doc-links` resolves every link of the corpus on the post-M1-M9 mdast and reports M10; give it the `--json` report to verify `#fragment` targets against ids observed in HTML. `check:content-schemas` validates the corpus against the real @vercel/geistdocs Zod schemas in about a second, so a bad frontmatter does not cost a whole build. All three run in the `docs-parity` CI job.
scripts.$comment:tgeist-14: TGEIST-14 (gate G6): same three commands as the old app, same script (scripts/render-example-thumbs.mjs is byte-identical to apps/docs'), pointed at THIS app's public/examples baselines -- which are the byte-identical PNGs transplanted from apps/docs, i.e. the pixel contract is shared, not re-baselined. They only produce meaningful pixels on a GPU-capable runtime (the docker-gpu job / infra/test-docker), never on a plain CI runner. `thumbs` rewrites the baselines (--update, never run in CI), `thumbs:check` compares against them, `render:proof` dumps 160x90 proofs to artifacts/example-renders for the CI artifact upload.
